description: Reusable preservation method profiles. Formats inherit family/domain templates and only use format-specific overrides when required. Extension/source rules are primary; broad category rules are fallback-only.

generic_preservation.label: Generic preservation baseline
steps: Preserve original file as submitted or acquired.
Record source, provenance, fixity and technical identifiers.
Run file identification and characterization where tooling is available.
Retain evidence of any normalization, migration or derivative creation.
validation: Run format identification against configured tools or registries.
Perform fixity validation before and after processing.
metadata_extraction: Record software/tool versions used during processing.
monitoring: Monitor authority-source changes and institutional readiness changes.

structured_text.label: Structured or plain text
validation: Check that the file is readable as text using the declared or detected encoding.
metadata_extraction: Extract declared encoding, namespaces, schemas or declared syntax where available.

structured_data.label: Structured data
steps: Treat the file as structured data, not only as displayable text.
Preserve delimiters, schema references, field names and structural conventions.
validation: Validate syntax or parseability where a parser or schema is available.
metadata_extraction: Extract declared schema, field names, delimiter conventions, encoding and record structure where available.
derivative_guidance: Generate access or analysis derivatives only when the original structured semantics remain preserved.

xml_based_structured_text.label: XML-based structured text
steps: Treat the file as structured data, not only as displayable text.
Preserve the original XML-based file as the preservation master.
validation: Validate against schema or documented conventions where available.
metadata_extraction: Extract root element, namespace, schema references and embedded metadata where available.
derivative_guidance: Create access or reuse derivatives only when they preserve the intended use case; do not replace the structured original with a flat display derivative.

scientific_data.label: Scientific data modifier
metadata_extraction: Extract domain-specific identifiers, units, measurements, coordinates or experimental context where available.
monitoring: Monitor domain-tool support as part of readiness.

chemistry_scientific_data.label: Chemistry/scientific data modifier
metadata_extraction: Extract molecule identifiers, formulae, atom/bond structures, coordinates and reaction information where available.
derivative_guidance: Use chemistry-aware tools for derivatives or reuse copies where required.
Do not treat PDF conversion as sufficient preservation for structured chemical semantics.
overrides: For CML and similar chemistry formats, preserve the structured source as the master and use chemistry-aware derivative workflows only for access or reuse.

raster_image.label: Raster image
validation: Run image characterization and validation where tools are available.
Record dimensions, color profile, bit depth, compression and embedded metadata.
derivative_guidance: Generate access derivatives separately from preservation masters.

office_document.label: Office document
steps: Generate tested preservation or access derivatives according to institutional readiness and policy.
validation: Check whether embedded content, macros or external dependencies are present.
derivative_guidance: Use tested conversion pathways such as PDF/A only when content and functionality requirements are met.

archive_or_container.label: Archive or container
steps: Inspect and assess contained files as separate preservation objects where feasible.
validation: Record internal file list, compression method and nested formats where available.
metadata_extraction: Extract contained file names, sizes, timestamps and identifiers where feasible.

geospatial_data.label: Geospatial data modifier
metadata_extraction: Extract coordinate reference system, geometry type, bounding boxes and linked resources where available.
derivative_guidance: Use geospatial-aware derivatives only where they preserve spatial meaning and dependencies.

audiovisual.label: Audiovisual
validation: Extract codec, container, duration, bitrate, frame rate, channel layout and embedded metadata where available.
derivative_guidance: Separate preservation masters from access derivatives.
